# anomaly_readiness (Data Source)

Whether this installation can actually page someone. Read it after the objects are in place to fail a pipeline that has left a hole in the alert path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anomaly_readiness" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `acknowledgement` (Attributes) Who accepted which blockers, and why. Null when nobody has. current is false once the set of blockers has changed since. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acknowledgement))
- `blocker_fingerprint` (String) Identifies the exact set of blockers; empty when there are none.
- `blockers` (Number)
- `checked_at` (String)
- `checks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--checks))
- `id` (String) Always set to "readiness".
- `production_ready` (Boolean) The weaker claim the activation gate uses: either nothing is in the way, or a named person accepted exactly the blockers listed here.
- `ready` (Boolean) Nothing is in the way.
- `warnings` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--acknowledgement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acknowledgement`

Read-Only:

- `actor` (String)
- `actor_id` (String)
- `at` (String)
- `current` (Boolean)
- `fingerprint` (String)
- `reason` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `checks`

Read-Only:

- `detail` (String)
- `items` (List of String) The specific objects at fault.
- `key` (String)
- `severity` (String) ok, warning or blocker. A check that could not run is reported as a blocker, never as a pass.
- `title` (String)
